# uapi_dhcp_server (Resource)

Dhcp server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uapi_dhcp_server" "example" {
  interface = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Network interface this entry applies to.

### Optional

- `dhcp_option` (List of String) DHCP options that dnsmasq sends, one per entry, such as `6,192.168.1.1`. dnsmasq.init passes each list entry whole, and dnsmasq reads it as one option. From uapi 3.2.0, an option that holds several words reads as one entry per word, as dnsmasq.init splits it. uapi 3.2.0 also refuses an entry in which an address is followed by whitespace and another option, such as `3,10.0.0.1 6,10.0.0.1`. A space in a text option, such as `15,my domain`, is valid.
- `dhcpv6` (String) uci option dhcpv6.
- `domain` (String) uci option domain.
- `dynamicdhcp` (Boolean) uci option dynamicdhcp.
- `force` (Boolean) uci option force.
- `id` (String) Resource id. Set it at create to choose the uci section name (e.g. `lan`); omit it to let uapi assign a prefixed ULID. Create-only: changing it forces replacement.
- `ignore` (Boolean) uci option ignore.
- `leasetime` (String) uci option leasetime.
- `limit` (Number) uci option limit.
- `ra` (String) uci option ra.
- `ra_default` (Number) uci option ra_default.
- `start` (Number) uci option start.

### Read-Only

- `etag` (String) Opaque ETag of the resource's current state, used for If-Match optimistic concurrency.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the underlying uci section is uapi-managed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a managed dhcp server by its stable id.
terraform import uapi_dhcp_server.example <id>

# Importing an anonymous (unmanaged) section adopts it (renames to a stable id).
terraform import uapi_dhcp_server.example cfg0a1b2c
```
